title: Energy Research and Publication Cluster
summary: This cluster revolves around the publication and research of energy-related topics. The BP Statistical Review of World Energy published the World Energy entity, while Energy Fuels published the fuel properties entity. Knothe G is associated with the creation of the fatty ester composition entity. The cluster includes various researchers and entities involved in energy research, including Atabani AE, Badruddin IA, Mahlia T, Mekhilef S, and Silitonga AS, all of which are likely connected to the energy research field.
